behavior: The server HTML of a range slider has the index, the value and the text of the value of each thumb, also when the thumbs have no `index` prop. A thumb takes its index from the order in which the thumbs render. Base UI needs the `index` prop on each thumb for a server render, because its list of thumbs fills only after the mount. The server HTML of a slider that has `Slider.Label` links the label. The root and the input of each thumb have the id of the label in `aria-labelledby`. The label can come before or after the control. Base UI links the label after the page hydrates.
